# Synthetic handoff fixture

Not a real secret. The values below are obvious fakes for the mask-check and gitleaks hook proof.

# First key is the low-entropy example. gitleaks aws-access-token requires
# entropy >= 3, so the second line is a higher-entropy synthetic key.
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=AKIAFAKEFAKEFAKEFAKE
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=AKIAFAKE2Q7M4N6P3R5W
email: test@example.com
SSN: 000-00-0000
